marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 25 knots diminishing to northwest 15 after
midnight and to light late Thursday morning. Wind becoming southeast 15 Thursday
evening. Scattered flurries. Temperatures near minus 3. Freezing spray ending after midnight. <br/>

marine.text:
Seas 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less late
overnight.<br/>
